# Project AI Instructions

Before making changes, read `docs/AI-DOCUMENTATION-INDEX.md` and then read only the documentation files relevant to the user's request.

For every task, follow `docs/GEMINI-RESTRICTIONS.md` and `docs/AI-RESTRICTIONS.md`. Do not delete files, modify important data, change Prisma schema or migrations, run destructive database commands, or make broad page rewrites without explicit user approval.

Use `docs/PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md` for architecture and scripts, `docs/CONVENTIONAL-COMMITS.md` for commit work, and `docs/CHANGELOG.md` when recording changes and to-do items.
